description: Reads one card revision related to the board root rootId. Invalid revisions are dropped (null); invalid optional fields are dropped on their own.

cases.name: a valid card with defaults
every optional field
invalid optional fields are dropped
a deadline of 0 is dropped
the latest deadline the protocol allows is kept
a deadline after year 9999 is dropped
a fractional deadline is dropped
a string deadline is dropped
a reminder at 0 is dropped
a reminder whose event id has a space is dropped
a thread id must have something after $
a thread id of 512 characters is kept
a thread id of 513 characters is dropped
a card id with a space is invalid
a card id with an underscore is invalid
an empty card id is invalid
a card id of 80 characters is valid
a card id of 81 characters is invalid
a thread card id is valid
a blank title is invalid
a title is read as written, untrimmed
a title of 200 characters is valid
a title of 201 characters is invalid
a title of 100 emoji is 200 UTF-16 code units
a title of 101 emoji is too long
a title of only U+FEFF is not blank
cases.note: JavaScript's trim() removes U+FEFF, so the web client drops this revision.

cases.name: a description of 4000 characters is valid
a description of 4001 characters is invalid
the description is required
an unknown column is invalid
columns are lowercase
the column is required
archived must be a boolean
archived is required
show_to_room true
a string show_to_room makes the revision invalid
a numeric show_to_room makes the revision invalid
a null show_to_room makes the revision invalid
version 2 is not read
a revision of another board is ignored
a thread relation is ignored
a redacted revision is ignored
another event type is ignored
ids are checked by code point: a combining mark may follow $
a thread id may hold a no-break space
cases.note: JavaScript's \S excludes U+00A0, so the web client drops this thread id.

cases.name: a thread id of 511 emoji is kept: its length counts code points
cases.note: JavaScript's \S without the u flag counts UTF-16 code units, so the web client drops this thread id.

cases.name: a title of only U+001C is blank
cases.note: JavaScript's trim() keeps U+001C to U+001F, so the web client reads this revision.
